about: Loop 3d-1: places where game/tools/check_drive.gd's findings are allowed. Every entry: kind (lane: a lane spot in collision; jump: an autopilot height jump), at (map metres), r (metres), name, why, source. Loop 3e built most of them; what is left is listed with its cause. Remove an entry when its cause is fixed (check_drive counts what it allowed; --no-allow counts every finding).
